sum: Real REMAX Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate technology company in the United States and Canada. The company provides title, mortgage, wallet, and franchising and ancillary services. It also offers ancillary services, including mortgage origination, title and escrow services, and financial technology and lending products. In addition, the company conducts educational conferences and networking events for training and developing new real estate professionals under the Real Young Professionals division. The company was formerly known as The Real Brokerage, Inc. and changed its name to Real REMAX Group Inc. in August 2026. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Miami, Florida.
